'''Anemara''' is an [[Accepted]] in the [[White Tower]].

==Appearance==
She is plump.

==Activities==
She comes to visit [[Tarna Feir]] with a woman wishing to present a petition to the [[Amyrlin Seat]]. Tarna tells her to give the woman some tea and tells her to wait, but [[Elaida]] is keen to give the woman an audience because she gets so few visitors and it would be a welcome change. This woman is actually [[Beonin Marinye]] in disguise.
